description: 50 hand-labelled UK tradesperson job notes for evaluating Sorted's notes-to-invoice parser. Amounts in GBP ex VAT; VAT 20% when vatEnabled. settings are the trader settings sent with each note.
labelConventions: Labour is hours x the trader's hourly rate unless the notes give another hourly or day rate; multiple workers multiply hours.
Parts are one line per priced item the notes list separately.
A callout is its own line; 'no charge' items get no line.
VAT applies when the trader is VAT registered or the notes say plus/on top/+ VAT; 'no vat' turns it off.
VAT-inclusive prices are split so the total equals the quoted price.
An empty customer name is correct when the notes name nobody.
